meta.rules:
Stage 7: canon data extracted by hand from the Atlas entries (read-only sources under
...\The Harold Project\The Histories\). Nothing is invented: people, titles, houses and relationships come only
from the entries' family trees, named-character lists and vassal lists. Unknowns are None and go to
data/data_gaps.md. Descriptions are short paraphrases. Snapshot: c. 2100 CR (Book One opening, M0); later
manuscript events go in LATER_EVENTS, never applied.

Liege rules used consistently (documented in data/data_gaps.md):
  - a reigning ruler has no liege (sovereign);
  - royal family members and crown officers answer to the ruler;
  - the head of a great vassal house answers to the ruler; members of that house answer to their head.

kingdoms.name: Calderra
kingdoms.description: Plains kingdom of western Caelora famed for cattle, horses and elite cavalry; proud, honour-bound and, since c. 1500 CR, markedly devout. Imports grain from Hamen; rebuilt a navy after the Great Betrayal.

kingdoms.name: Astera
kingdoms.government: elective theocracy: the High Aster Order (High Pontiff elected for life by the Curia; no crown, no bloodline)
kingdoms.description: Religious capital and mediating power of northern Caelora; wealthy in tithes and pilgrims, defended but never projecting force (Calderra's faith is its only sword arm). Keeps the History Keepers and a buried older faith.

kingdoms.name: Madravella
kingdoms.government: elective monarchy within the royal family (the Council of Blood elects any true-born member)
kingdoms.description: Small, rich, scholarly kingdom on the open Oravian plains: vineyards, the great university and the continent's best intelligence network. Free for six centuries; above all it wants to prevent a general war.

kingdoms.name: Valdora
kingdoms.government: hereditary monarchy, strict birth order regardless of gender (House Corivane)
kingdoms.description: Master of the Great Gate and the Canyon Road at the Ventara canyon's western mouth; taxes nearly all traffic between Kervara and the plains; a pragmatic, process-run state. Founded c. 500 CR by betraying Thrennor.

kingdoms.name: Kervara
kingdoms.government: hereditary monarchy (eldest child), governed day to day by the King's Hand, a Dravenne relative, by custom
kingdoms.description: Unconquered mountain military kingdom in the basin at the Ventara canyon's east end; rich in iron, gold, silver and craftsmen; sells the best mercenary companies in Caelora. Its crown descends from the usurper Garreth.

kingdoms.name: Salmara
kingdoms.government: hereditary Princeps (strict succession in House Salmara) presiding over the Merchant Council, whose assent is required for war
kingdoms.description: The wealthiest merchant kingdom of the Middle Sea: salt, banking, credit, insurance and shipping; newly and lavishly armed. Its fleet lies in tidal flats behind a bar that gates sailing on the tide.

kingdoms.name: The Dovaran Crown
kingdoms.government: hereditary monarchy, strict male primogeniture; the loyalty of the great captain-houses must be re-earned
kingdoms.description: Island monarchy of the limestone Clearwater archipelago (Lofoten cliffs in an Aegean sea), ruling the Middle Sea's navigation, tolls and storm lore from Dovehall; takes tribute from Hamen; about 100,000 people fed entirely by trade. Senior Marcellus line (the Kervara claim).
kingdoms.source: The Histories\Caelora\Dovaran Crown\Dovaran Crown Atlas Entry.md

kingdoms.name: Hamen
kingdoms.description: The River Flame kingdom on both banks of the Flame: canal-fed surplus grain, trade 'with anyone', a doctrine of bleeding for no one; has paid House Dove tribute for three and a half centuries while Queen Meret secretly builds a fleet.
kingdoms.source: The Histories\Quadria\The River Flame Chronicles\Hamen Atlas Entry.md

kingdoms.name: The Coastal Sultanate
kingdoms.government: Sultanate (the Sultan is unnamed in canon)
kingdoms.description: Wealthiest of the four Sultanates: harbours, ships and trade on Quadria's northern shore, north-west of the High Dunes; home of the Tide Court, single combat aboard anchored ships sacred to Tarek.
kingdoms.source: The Histories\Quadria\The Dune Sea Chronoicles\Coastal Sultanate Atlas Entry.md

kingdoms.name: The High Dunes
kingdoms.government: tribal: clan leadership, no Sultan and no single throne (by design)
kingdoms.description: The purest surviving Bedouin culture of the Dune Sea: horse-breeding, camel cavalry, clan over dynasty. Karn Ashur sits within its territory without answering to it.
kingdoms.source: The Histories\Quadria\The Dune Sea Chronoicles\High Dunes Atlas Entry.md

kingdoms.name: The Oasis League
kingdoms.government: Sultanate over a league of oasis-towns and temples (Sultan unnamed)
kingdoms.description: Rich, scholarly and temple-dense; closest of the successor states to the Ashen Order and Karn Ashur's Library; judge-priests and record-keeping.
kingdoms.source: The Histories\Quadria\The Dune Sea Chronoicles\Oasis League Atlas Entry.md

kingdoms.name: The Southern Salt Sultanate
kingdoms.description: Salt mines, copper and siege-proof desert fortresses; self-sufficient and defensively patient.
kingdoms.source: The Histories\Quadria\The Dune Sea Chronoicles\Southern Salt Sultanate Atlas Entry.md

kingdoms.name: The Eastern Marches
kingdoms.description: The old frontier with Hamen; small grinding border wars; exports mercenary companies.
kingdoms.source: The Histories\Quadria\The Dune Sea Chronoicles\Eastern Marches Atlas Entry.md

kingdoms.name: Karn Ashur
kingdoms.government: neutral temple-city under the Ashen Order; claimed by none of the five successor states (not a kingdom)
kingdoms.description: The Temple of the First Flame on the High Dunes' great peak: Al-Mirah's spring at its base, a flame at the summit, the Ashen Order and its Library; three thousand years of untouched neutrality. Fed in part by Hamen grain; shelters House Qadir's hidden slave-trafficking network.
kingdoms.source: The Histories\Quadria\The Dune Sea Chronoicles\Karn Ashur Atlas Entry.md

kingdoms.name: Varduun
kingdoms.government: elective chiefdom: the High Chief wins the Trial-Seat through the Trials, ending in the weaponless Pit of Stone; no hereditary throne, ever
kingdoms.description: Rebuilt mountain people of the jungled basalt highlands near the River Flame's source: the Seven Great Clans, the Council of Elders and the Trials; iron, stonework and hard mercenaries; haunted by Old Karr's warning.
kingdoms.ruling_body: The Seven Great Clans and the Council of Elders

kingdoms.name: Vesperra
kingdoms.description: The lightly detailed western continent across the Duskward Sea; name is a placeholder.

kingdoms.name: Thrasia
kingdoms.description: The remote eastern continent across the Dawnward Sea, mostly unknown; the Silent Coast, the Pale Mountains, the Interior Silence.

characters.name: Osric Caldravi
characters.title: King (deceased)

characters.name: Tavian Caldravi
characters.title: King of Calderra
characters.description: Reigning king: grey, stoic and exacting in public, privately weary and cautious, haunted by his house's thousand years of costly ambition.
characters.age_source: The Histories\Book One - Main Character Sheet.md

characters.name: Landric Caldravi
characters.title: Prince, heir to the throne
characters.description: Charismatic heir and finest horseman of his generation; impatient with his father's caution; privately cruel to those who cannot hold him to account.
characters.age_source: The Histories\Book One - Main Character Sheet.md

characters.name: Yseult Caldravi
characters.title: Princess
characters.description: Landric's wife, born to House Ashvane of Astera; devout, observant, uneasy about the old imperial dream.
characters.age_source: The Histories\Book One - Main Character Sheet.md

characters.name: Elenor Caldravi
characters.title: Princess
characters.description: Landric and Yseult's daughter, nearly of age; betrothed to Tomlin Vantry to bind House Vantry to the crown.
characters.age_source: The Histories\Book One - Main Character Sheet.md

characters.name: Dorric Caldravi
characters.title: Prince, commander of the royal cavalry
characters.description: The king's younger brother; a loyal soldier, stung at being second-born; at odds with the navy over funding.

characters.name: Renn Caldravi
characters.title: Lord
characters.description: Dorric's son, Landric's first cousin; a gifted cavalry commander who privately resents birth order.
characters.age_source: The Histories\Book One - Main Character Sheet.md

characters.name: Isolde Caldravi
characters.title: Lady (religious life at Astera)
characters.description: Dorric's daughter; took up religious life at Astera; the family's clear-eyed moral conscience.
characters.age_source: The Histories\Book One - Main Character Sheet.md

characters.name: Alys Corivane (born Caldravi)
characters.title: Princess of House Corivane
characters.description: The king's sister, married into Valdora; Calderra's sharpest unofficial back-channel to Valdora.
characters.source: The Histories\Caelora\Calderra\Calderra Atlas Entry.md ; The Histories\Caelora\Valdora\Valdora Atlas Entry.md
characters.note: Canon inconsistency #3 (deliberate): Calderra's entry says she married 'a Valdoran lord's house'; Valdora's entry says House Corivane's royal line. Liege left unset here; see the Valdora extraction.
characters.age_source: The Histories\Book One - Main Character Sheet.md

characters.name: Halden Caldravi
characters.title: Duke
characters.description: The king's uncle; elder statesman and war veteran who counsels restraint.

characters.name: Ossane Vayle
characters.title: Admiral of the navy
characters.description: Common-born commander of the rebuilt navy; blunt, merit-risen, outside the old aristocracy.

characters.name: Emeric Fenmark
characters.title: Lord Chancellor
characters.description: The crown's senior adviser; meticulous, unglamorous and genuinely loyal.

characters.name: Aldous Vantry
characters.title: Ser, Lord of House Vantry
characters.description: Old-school head of the great inland cavalry house; sees the navy as a loss of nerve.

characters.name: Tomlin Vantry
characters.title: Heir of House Vantry
characters.description: Aldous's eldest son and heir; betrothed to Princess Elenor.

characters.name: Serane Ossmere
characters.title: Lady, head of House Ossmere
characters.description: Sharp, patient head of the coastal house; funds naval expansion and admires Admiral Vayle; loyal to the crown.

characters.name: Dennet Calloway
characters.title: Ser, Lord of House Calloway
characters.description: Pragmatic head of the Salt Road toll house; probably the shrewdest of the great vassals.

characters.name: Theodorus
characters.title: High Pontiff
characters.description: Serene, beloved head of the order; privately doubts whether his decades in office made the faith safer and emptier at once.
characters.age_source: The Histories\Book One - Main Character Sheet.md

characters.name: Sertorius
characters.title: Prelate of the Curia
characters.description: Severe ascetic handling pilgrimage security and diplomacy; suspects the Tithed has a source inside the order.

characters.name: Damaris
characters.title: Prelate of the Curia
characters.description: Warm, senior and devout; privately unsettled that the old faith's critique may be right.

characters.name: Tullia
characters.title: Magister, head of the History Keepers and archives
characters.description: Brisk archivist protecting the archive's completeness, including the restricted old texts.

characters.name: Rufus
characters.title: "the Ashfather", leader of the Tithed
characters.description: Burn-scarred leader who has drawn the leaderless Tithed cult together for the first time in generations.
characters.note: Leader of a secret cult; no liege by design.
characters.age_source: The Histories\Book One - Main Character Sheet.md

characters.name: Ambrose
characters.title: Brother (expelled clergyman)
characters.description: Former cleric cast out on suspicion of favouring the old faith; taught Rufus to read and brought him to the Tithed.

characters.name: Thevar Serravene
characters.title: King (deceased)
characters.description: Previous king; his death triggered the Council of Blood vote.

characters.name: Isabeau Serravene
characters.title: Queen of Madravella
characters.description: Youngest of three, elected for her cunning; quiet, watchful, comfortable being underestimated.
characters.age_source: The Histories\Book One - Main Character Sheet.md

characters.name: Corentin Serravene
characters.title: Prince, master of the crown's intelligence

characters.age_source: The Histories\Book One - Main Character Sheet.md

characters.name: Perrine Serravene

characters.age_source: The Histories\Book One - Main Character Sheet.md

characters.name: Davin Serravene

characters.age_source: The Histories\Book One - Main Character Sheet.md

characters.name: Perrin Vashe

characters.age_source: The Histories\Book One - Main Character Sheet.md

characters.name: Severin Corivane

characters.age_source: The Histories\Book One - Main Character Sheet.md

characters.name: Renata Corivane
characters.title: Queen

characters.name: Miriel Corivane

characters.age_source: The Histories\Book One - Main Character Sheet.md

characters.name: Varen Corivane

characters.age_source: The Histories\Book One - Main Character Sheet.md

characters.name: Elara Corivane

characters.age_source: The Histories\Book One - Main Character Sheet.md

characters.name: Ardin Vallenar

characters.name: Renzo Dellorin
characters.title: second son of House Dellorin

characters.name: Tormund Marcellus
characters.title: King (deceased)

characters.name: Elira Marcellus
characters.title: Queen (deceased)

characters.name: Ossian Marcellus

characters.age_source: The Histories\Book One - Main Character Sheet.md

characters.name: Sabine Marcellus
characters.title: Queen
characters.description: Born House Dravenne; the clearest-eyed person in the palace about what the Hand arrangement is.
characters.age_source: The Histories\Book One - Main Character Sheet.md

characters.name: Doran Marcellus

characters.name: Corwin Marcellus

characters.name: Bram Marcellus

characters.name: Hale Marcellus

characters.title: Master of the Assurance (Cortavel)
characters.description: Younger, prouder Cortavel master.

characters.name: Aurelio Vassaro
characters.title: Captain, senior captain of the southern anchorage
characters.description: The fleet's respected professional; checks Tarquin to his face.

characters.name: Petrus Baro
characters.title: salt-pond man, carried on the fleet's books
characters.description: Of Calla Vecchia.

characters.name: Peregrine Dove
characters.title: King of the Dovaran Crown
characters.description: Steady, weathered commander; carries every Dove monarch's dread of seeming unable to protect his own.
characters.source: The Histories\Caelora\Dovaran Crown\Dovaran Crown Atlas Entry.md
characters.age_source: The Histories\Book One - Main Character Sheet.md

characters.name: Halcyon Dove
characters.title: Queen
characters.description: Runs Dovehall's intelligence and court; as central as the king to keeping it steady.
characters.source: The Histories\Caelora\Dovaran Crown\Dovaran Crown Atlas Entry.md
characters.age_source: The Histories\Book One - Main Character Sheet.md

characters.name: Talon Dove
characters.title: Prince, heir
characters.description: Heir who commands at sea in person; respected by captains twice his age.
characters.source: The Histories\Caelora\Dovaran Crown\Dovaran Crown Atlas Entry.md
characters.age_source: The Histories\Book One - Main Character Sheet.md

characters.name: Harrier Dove
characters.title: Prince (Fairborn, barred from succession)
characters.description: Fairborn warrior raised apart; calm, settled purpose as the blade beside the throne.
characters.source: The Histories\Caelora\Dovaran Crown\Dovaran Crown Atlas Entry.md
characters.age_source: The Histories\Book One - Main Character Sheet.md

characters.name: Wren Dove
characters.title: Princess
characters.description: Capable and trusted at court; outside the succession and content to be; declares voyages cursed half in jest.
characters.source: The Histories\Caelora\Dovaran Crown\Dovaran Crown Atlas Entry.md
characters.age_source: The Histories\Book One - Main Character Sheet.md

characters.name: Alder Thorne
characters.title: Lord, head of House Thorne
characters.description: Loudest voice at Dovehall on naval policy; loyal beyond question.
characters.source: The Histories\Caelora\Dovaran Crown\Dovaran Crown Atlas Entry.md

characters.name: Brant Thorne
characters.title: Captain
characters.description: Alder's youngest son; hard, professional, argues a plan then executes the version he lost.
characters.source: The Histories\Caelora\Dovaran Crown\Dovaran Crown Atlas Entry.md

characters.name: Rowan Thorne
characters.title: First mate of the home fleet
characters.description: Alder's cousin's grandson; taught Prince Talon his splices.
characters.source: The Histories\Caelora\Dovaran Crown\Dovaran Crown Atlas Entry.md

characters.name: Meret Amaranth
characters.title: Queen of Hamen
characters.description: Widowed, unreadable queen who walks her own fields; secretly building a war fleet disguised as harbour renewal.
characters.source: The Histories\Quadria\The River Flame Chronicles\Hamen Atlas Entry.md
characters.age_source: The Histories\Book One - Main Character Sheet.md

characters.name: Nahla Amaranth
characters.title: Crown Princess, heir
characters.description: Warmer in public; has privately known for a year that her mother forged the harbour-renewal accounts.
characters.source: The Histories\Quadria\The River Flame Chronicles\Hamen Atlas Entry.md
characters.age_source: The Histories\Book One - Main Character Sheet.md

characters.name: Darius Amaranth
characters.title: Prince, overseer of granaries and canals
characters.description: Meret's younger brother; a true believer in the farmer-king ethos, unsettled by her secrecy.
characters.source: The Histories\Quadria\The River Flame Chronicles\Hamen Atlas Entry.md
characters.age_source: The Histories\Book One - Main Character Sheet.md

characters.name: Yara Nereth
characters.title: Warden, head of House Nereth
characters.description: Proud head of the canal house; has questioned the diversion of labour to 'harbour renewal'.
characters.source: The Histories\Quadria\The River Flame Chronicles\Hamen Atlas Entry.md

characters.name: Farid Dareth
characters.title: Keeper, head of House Dareth
characters.description: Obsessive keeper of the Archive; keeps the Marakai treason file marked unresolved.
characters.source: The Histories\Quadria\The River Flame Chronicles\Hamen Atlas Entry.md

characters.name: Rahim Iskandar
characters.title: Lord Warden, head of House Iskandar
characters.description: Frontier lord long distrusted for his loyalty; trusted by Meret with much of the fleet's secret.
characters.source: The Histories\Quadria\The River Flame Chronicles\Hamen Atlas Entry.md

characters.name: Renna Voss
characters.title: Marshal, head of House Voss
characters.description: Commands a disciplined, long-unused army; quietly ready for the fleet to matter.
characters.source: The Histories\Quadria\The River Flame Chronicles\Hamen Atlas Entry.md

characters.name: Mira Selenne
characters.title: High Shrine-Keeper, head of House Selenne
characters.description: Performs every crown ceremony; blessed the fleet unknowingly and has since pieced it together.
characters.source: The Histories\Quadria\The River Flame Chronicles\Hamen Atlas Entry.md

characters.name: Yasmin Fenn
characters.title: Lady, head of House Fenn
characters.description: Sharp merchant head; the 'harbour renewal' spending doesn't add up to any harbour she can find.
characters.source: The Histories\Quadria\The River Flame Chronicles\Hamen Atlas Entry.md

characters.name: Vareth
characters.title: High Chief (the Uniter of Stone)
characters.description: Rose from an ordinary Morvek mining family and won the Pit; recites Old Karr's warning at every Trial, fearing it is ageing out of his people.
characters.age_source: The Histories\Book One - Main Character Sheet.md

characters.name: Kessa Karr
characters.title: Elder, keeper of the Trials and the Pit
characters.description: Exacting enforcer of the Pit's rules, even against favoured claimants.
characters.note: The Trials answer to no one's convenience; no liege set by design.
characters.age_source: The Histories\Book One - Main Character Sheet.md

characters.name: Dessin Brekan
characters.title: Lord, head of Great Clan Brekan
characters.description: Loudest Council voice arguing that 'never again' has curdled into timidity toward Hamen.
characters.age_source: The Histories\Book One - Main Character Sheet.md

settlements.name: Salmara
settlements.description: Capital of Salmara at the Oravo mouth: tidal flats, canals, levees, windmills, salt ponds, warehouses and immense white salt mounds.

settlements.name: Ruins of Oravessa
settlements.description: Ruins of the Velharian Empire's capital, 'the Crown of Caelora': now Calderran grazing land with a roofless columned hall, palace fragments and aqueduct stubs.

settlements.name: Calderra
settlements.description: Walled coastal capital of the cavalry kingdom, with the royal stables and the rebuilt navy's harbour. Its site: the sheltered head of its natural harbour, where the Aurenna comes down to the water, with the Tavian Aqueduct coming down off the high ground behind it (author direction 2026-09-28).

settlements.name: Astera
settlements.description: Holy city of temples, cathedrals, monasteries, bridges, libraries and pilgrim houses in the Veryan foothills; seat of the High Pontiff; sealed shrines beneath.

settlements.name: Madravella
settlements.description: Scholarly capital on the open Oravian plains: the great university amid vineyards.

settlements.name: Corivessa / Great Gate
settlements.description: Corivessa, Valdora's capital, built against the Great Gate that closes the Ventara canyon's western mouth; master of the Canyon Road.

settlements.name: Kervara
settlements.description: Unconquered mountain fortress-city in its basin at the canyon's east end; kings are crowned facing out at the outer gate.

settlements.name: Dovehall
settlements.description: The White Castle: pale limestone capital of the Dovaran Crown, its harbour guarded by reefs, hidden rocks and shifting currents.
settlements.source: output/places_resolved.json (position); The Histories\Caelora\Dovaran Crown\Dovaran Crown Atlas Entry.md

settlements.name: Haven
settlements.description: Capital of Hamen on the River Flame floodplain: Erros the Founder's outer wall, inner defences and the stepped pyramid-palaces.
settlements.source: output/places_resolved.json (position); The Histories\Quadria\The River Flame Chronicles\Hamen Atlas Entry.md

settlements.name: Karn Ashur
settlements.description: The Temple of the First Flame: temple-city on the great peak, Al-Mirah's spring at its foot, a flame at the summit; seat of the Ashen Order and its Library.
settlements.source: output/places_resolved.json (position); The Histories\Quadria\The Dune Sea Chronoicles\Karn Ashur Atlas Entry.md

settlements.name: Calloway seat
settlements.description: Ancestral seat of House Calloway: a great market city where the Salt Road from Salmara to Calderra crosses the old imperial road from Oravessa to Astera. The Calloways hold the Salt Road through Calderra and grow rich on its tolls. Name not yet given.
settlements.source: Calderra Atlas Entry (House Calloway); author direction 2026-09-28 (site)

settlements.name: Corivessa port
settlements.description: Valdora's sea port for Corivessa and the Great Gate, on the bay south-west of the city; the country between it and the Calderran border is bandit-ridden marsh and broken hills, with no army road to Calderra. Name not yet given.

settlements.name: Ossmere port
settlements.description: Seat of House Ossmere: the great port and trade city across the bay from Calderra, and the base of the rebuilt Calderran navy under Admiral Ossane Vayle. The Ossmeres grew rich and influential on the naval rebuilding. Name not yet given.
settlements.source: Calderra Atlas Entry (House Ossmere, Admiral Vayle); author direction 2026-09-28 (site)

later_events.text: Miriel Corivane is assassinated by the Tithed at Astera; Varen kills the assassins.
later_events.source: The Histories\Canon Decisions & Known Issues.md (Present-Day Snapshot Discipline)

later_events.when: brewed in Book One; declared at Book Two's opening
later_events.text: The Valdora-Astera war grows out of the assassination; Calderra sides with Astera.
later_events.source: The Histories\Canon Decisions & Known Issues.md (Present-Day Snapshot Discipline)

later_events.text: Prince Tormund, Corwin and Selia's son, is born.
Ossian dies naturally at 61; Corwin is crowned facing out at ~M14-15, renews the warrants and leaves Master Sern standing (Ostred Vance becomes Doorward).
Corwin is killed in a staged accident; Halvard's regency for the infant Tormund.
Petrus Baro loses two fingers on Tarquin's second readiness trial.
later_events.source: The Histories\Caelora\Salmara\Salmara Atlas Entry.md ; The Histories\Canon Decisions & Known Issues.md

later_events.text: The Council votes to dredge the bar; afterwards no Salmaran sailing is gated by tide.
later_events.source: The Histories\Caelora\Salmara\Salmara Atlas Entry.md ; The Histories\Canon Decisions & Known Issues.md

later_events.text: Lucan and Tarquin take a minority of the fleet toward Dovehall without authorisation; Vassaro refuses; Varro's recall goes unanswered.
later_events.source: The Histories\Caelora\Salmara\Salmara Atlas Entry.md ; The Histories\Canon Decisions & Known Issues.md

later_events.when: a few chapters into Book One
later_events.text: Queen Meret Amaranth's secret fleet destroys Talon's squadron, breaking three and a half centuries of tribute; Talon and Harrier survive the wreck and cross the Dune Sea coast.
later_events.source: The Histories\Caelora\Dovaran Crown\Dovaran Crown Atlas Entry.md

geography.name: Oravian Expanse
geography.status: Divided among Salmara, Astera and Calderra (author direction 2026-09-28; was contested)
geography.description: The rolling hill country of the Oravian Expanse between the Caeloran realms. The author has divided it among its neighbours, with the Border river as the boundary of Salmara against Astera and Calderra. Its division is part of the PROVISIONAL territory map.
